text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While waiting for her race, Yamanin Zephyr 
was pacing around the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, do not worry. I am merely 
surrendering myself to the wind arising 
from within.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A fierce whirlwind is dancing within me. 
Blowing through swiftly, ready to sweep up 
everything in its path—!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I know I shouldn't rush ahead, but... I'm 
itching to go play with the wind.
choice_data_list: You're fully fired up, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Today, I shall whip up a swift-footed 
typhoon!
